# Chapter 3 — global sequence, local reuse

The Constitution appears again in this chapter as a new page-local footnote numbered **5**.^[See [@brasil1988]{.bibentry}]

A repeated occurrence reuses footnote **5**.^[See [@brasil1988]{.bibentry}]

José Afonso da Silva then receives footnote **6** in this chapter.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

This demonstrates the book-wide numbering variant: **each chapter page owns its footnotes, while the visible numbering continues across the book**.
